answer: The dune register is checked at draw time, garden lists the eligible set, and sable seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 24 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an farming party pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 24 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 34 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
